name: Master's Glaive
summary: In southwestern Darkshore, Twilight's Hammer cultists now swarm around the Master's Glaive. Night elves once revered this ancient site, where a colossal weapon and a petrified skull recall a forgotten clash.

sections.title: A Monument of an Ancient Clash
sections.body: At the Master's Glaive, an adamantine blade pierces a colossal petrified skull. No record names the creature or the hand that drove the blade home. Onu, the Ancient of Lore, says only that an old, old lord of the earth fell here. For generations, night elves believed only the titans could wield a weapon so vast. The blade and skull remain as a monument to that forgotten clash.

sections.title: Dark Excavations
sections.body: For generations, night elves held the Master's Glaive in solemn reverence. Now Twilight's Hammer fanatics camp around the sunken carcass, digging trenches and uncovering petrified ribs. Whispers beneath the stone draw them to study the remains and commune with the malevolent power that clings to them. They seek to revive or harness whatever fell essence sleeps within the earth.

faq.q: What is the massive weapon stuck in the skull?
faq.answer: No one knows for certain. The colossal adamantine blade is the Master's Glaive, driven into the skull in some forgotten age. Night elves believed only the titans could wield a weapon of such size.

faq.q: What creature's skull is buried here?
aliases: who is buried at masters glaive
faq.answer: The creature's name is lost. Onu, the Ancient of Lore, says only that an old, old lord of the earth fell here. Twilight's Hammer believes the petrified remains belong to a servant of the Old Gods.

faq.q: Why is the Twilight's Hammer cult gathered here?
faq.answer: The Twilight's Hammer cult worships the Old Gods. Its members have overrun the Master's Glaive to excavate the petrified remains. Lingering dark power draws them, and they hope to restore the fallen creature to life.

faq.q: Who knows about the history of this site?
faq.answer: Onu, the Ancient of Lore in Darkshore, recognizes the site as the resting place of an ancient lord of the earth. He bids investigators look into it.

angles.text: As a night elf, you know the strange petrified monument was a solemn holy place for generations. Twilight's Hammer has defiled Darkshore's sacred grounds.
